messages.subject: annotate in facet_wrap
parts:
Dear list members,

How to annotate text in only one of the graph of a facet_wrap?

x = rnorm(1:10)
y = rnorm(1:10)
sitio = c("a", "b")
df = data.frame(x,y, sitio)
df
p = ggplot(df, aes(x, y))
p + geom_point() + theme_bw() + facet_wrap(~sitio, scales="free") +
annotate("text", x=-0.5, y=0.2, label="This point")

but I want only in graph "a".

Best,

Manuel
